Writing Toy Software Is A Joy
Why you should write more toy programs
2025-06-15
|
↩️
10
│
🔄
18
│
⭐
36
I am a huge fan of Richard Feyman’s famous quote:
“What I cannot create, I do not understand”
I think it’s brilliant, and it remains true across many fields (if you’re willing to be a little creative with the
definition of ‘create’). It is to this principle that I believe I owe everything I’m truly good at. Some will tell you
to avoid reinventing the wheel, but they’re wrong: you
should
build your own wheel, because it’ll teach you more about
how they work than reading a thousand books on them ever will.
In 2025, the beauty and craft of writing software is being eroded. AI is threatening to replace us (or, at least, the
most joyful aspects of our craft) and software development is being increasingly commodified, measured, packaged, and
industrialised. Software development needs more simple joy, and I’ve found that creating toy programs is a great way to
remember why I started working with computers again.
Keep it simple
Toy programs follow the 80:20 rule: 20% of the work, 80% of the functionality. The point is
not
to build
production-worthy software (although it is true that some of the best production software began life as a toy).
Aggressively avoid over-engineering, restrict yourself to only whatever code is necessary to achieve your goal. Have
every code path panic/crash until you’re forced to implement it to make progress. You might be surprised by just how
easy it is to build toy versions of software you might previously have considered to be insummountably difficult to
create.
Other benefits
I’ve been consistently surprised by just how often some arcane nugget of knowledge I’ve acquired when working on a toy
project has turned out to be immensely valuable in my day job, either by giving me a head-start on tracking down a
problem in a tool or library, or by recognising mistakes before they’re made.
Understanding the constraints that define the shape of software is vital for working with it, and there’s no better way
to gain insight into those constraints than by running into them head-first. You might even come up with some novel
solutions!
The list
Here is a list of toy programs I’ve attempted over the past 15 years, rated by difficulty and time required. These
ratings are estimates and assume that you’re already comfortable with at least one general-purpose programming language
and that, like me, you tend to only have an hour or two per day free to write code. Also included are some suggested
resources that I found useful.
Regex engine (difficulty = 4/10, time = 5 days)
A regex engine that can read a POSIX-style regex program and recognise strings that match it. Regex is simple yet
shockingly expressive, and writing a competent regex engine will teach you everything you need to know about using the
language too.
Wikipedia: Regex
x86 OS kernel (difficulty = 7/10, time = 2 months)
A multiboot-compatible OS kernel with a simple CLI, keyboard/mouse driver, ANSI escape sequence support, memory manager,
scheduler, etc. Additional challenges include writing an in-memory filesystem, user mode and process isolation, loading
ELF executables, and supporting enough video hardware to render a GUI.
OS Dev Wiki
GameBoy/NES emulator (difficulty = 6/10, time = 3 weeks)
A crude emulator for the simplest GameBoy or NES games. The GB and the NES are classics, and both have relatively simple
instruction sets and peripheral hardware. Additional challenges include writing competent PPU (video) and PSG (audio)
implementations, along with dealing with some of the more exotic cartridge formats.
GB Dev
NES Dev Wiki
GameBoy Advance game (difficulty = 3/10, time = 2 weeks)
A sprite-based game (top-down or side-on platform). The GBA is a beautiful little console to write code for and there’s
an active and dedicated development community for the console. I truly believe that the GBA is one of the last game
consoles that can be fully and completely understood by a single developer, right down to instruction timings.
Tonc
GBATEK
Physics engine (difficulty = 5/10, time = 1 week)
A 2D rigid body physics engine that implements Newtonian physics with support for rectangles, circles, etc. On the
simplest end, just spheres that push away from one-another is quite simple to implement. Things start to get complex
when you introduce more complex shapes, angular momentum, and the like. Additional challenges include making collision
resolution fast and scaleable, having complex interactions move toward a steady state over time, soft-body interactions,
etc.
Dynamic interpreter (difficulty = 4/10, time = 1-2 weeks)
A tree-walking interpreter for a JavaScript-like language with basic flow control. There’s an unbounded list of extra
things to add to this one, but being able to write programs in my own language still gives me child-like elation. It
feels like a sort of tech

主要讨论点：AR/VR技术在各行业应用的现状、挑战与未来发展

不同观点：
• **AR技术在工业中的实际应用有显著效果，但硬件限制明显**：  
  [isk517] 表示Hololens 2在质量检查中显著提高了工作效率，但硬件性能接近极限，需要升级。大型公司对AR的利润前景存疑，导致技术发展缓慢。

• **VR技术在办公室环境中的健康风险与舒适性问题突出**：  
  [edent] 指出VR头显在共享使用中的健康风险、佩戴不适以及隔离感问题，特别是在办公环境中应用有限。

• **AR眼镜在缓解视觉疲劳方面有潜力，但设计与视野问题仍需改进**：  
  [j-wags] 分享了使用TCL Rayneo Air 2显示眼镜的体验，认为其在缓解眼疲劳方面有帮助，但设计和视野问题仍需改进。

• **过去十年AR设备的应用效果不佳，主要受限于硬件与内容问题**：  
  [idkwhattocallme] 总结了过去十年AR设备在实际应用中的问题，如设备笨重、价格高、易损坏、电池寿命短等，且大多数客户缺乏有效的内容支持。

• **AR在培训和实时操作支持中的应用**：  
  [spookie] 指出AR在培训（如消防员培训）中的应用，但电池寿命和设备防护是主要障碍。

• **VR/AR技术在CAD数据可视化与协作中的潜在价值**：  
  [jlarocco] 讨论了VR在CAD数据可视化中的应用潜力，但质疑其是否能带来足够的价值以抵消购买和部署头显的成本。

• **AR设备市场即将迎来新一轮创新，社会接受度逐步提高**：  
  [gavinray] 和 [quantumquetzal] 提到即将推出的Google/Samsung和Meta的AR设备，以及当前一些轻量级AR眼镜在社会接受度方面的进展。

• **VR在远程工作环境中的潜力应用**：  
  [geocrasher] 和 [codybontecou] 讨论了Oculus 3和Apple Vision Pro在虚拟桌面环境和远程工作中的应用潜力。

• **XR技术在建筑行业中的早期应用与持续发展**：  
  [fn-mote] 和 [ugolino91] 提到建筑行业早期采用VR技术展示设计概念，并持续在工程和建筑领域推动AR/VR平台的发展。

• **AR/VR技术在各行业中的应用挑战与接受度问题**：  
  [curiouscavalier] 指出AR/VR技术在各行业应用中的多重障碍，如设备可靠性、工作流程改变、安全问题、软件开发技能要求和可访问性问题，导致大规模应用受限。

补充讨论：
• **AR/VR设备的社会接受度与设计舒适性是广泛应用的关键**：  
  多个评论提到了设备佩戴舒适性、社会接受度以及设计问题，这些问题被认为是AR/VR技术广泛应用的主要障碍。

• **AR/VR技术在特定行业中的实际应用案例与未来潜力**：  
  评论中提到了AR/VR技术在培训、建筑、工程等特定行业中的实际应用案例，并对其未来发展持谨慎乐观态度。

争议焦点：
• **AR/VR技术是否能带来足够的商业价值以抵消其成本和应用障碍**：  
  部分评论认为AR/VR技术在特定行业中具有显著应用潜力，但也有评论指出其在商业应用中的障碍和挑战，质疑其广泛应用的可行性。

data.title: PlasticList – Plastic Levels in Foods
data.author: homebrewer
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：塑料对食品的污染及其潜在健康影响

不同观点：
• **dredmorbius** 认为塑料研磨器（尤其是内置于调料瓶中的那种）随着使用时间的增加，可能会将塑料颗粒磨入食物中，这是一种不应存在的产品设计。他引用了一个5年前的讨论，并指出在沃尔玛等平台上仍有此类产品销售。

• **any1** 提出食品中的微塑料更多可能来源于工业加工过程，而非包装或家用塑料制品。他以自己在食品加工设备公司工作的经验为例，指出工厂中的塑料粉尘可能通过高压水枪清洗流入海洋，而不是直接进入食品。

• **showerst** 引用了DEHP和DEHT的“安全限量”，并认为即便依赖于含有塑料包装的食品（如RXBars和Sweetgreen），摄入量仍然远低于安全限量，因此不必过度担忧。

• **xnx** 质疑为何塑料污染获得大量关注，而糖分或酒精过量消费等已证实的健康问题却没有得到同等重视。他认为这种关注度不平衡可能导致对潜在健康风险的误解。

• **eestrada** 担心即便是未加工的牛奶也可能含有塑料，因为挤奶机中的塑料管可能会导致牛奶中混入微塑料。

• **dmm** 提出一个历史性的疑问：1920年代的可可粉中为何检测到1930年代才合成的DEHP，质疑这些检测结果的准确性或来源。

• **perrygeo** 对塑料研究持怀疑态度，提到过去关于“人脑中含有塑料勺量微塑料”的研究因方法论问题而被推翻，呼吁对当前研究方法进行审视。

补充讨论：
• **cheeseomlit** 和 **aydyn** 分别对特定食品（如全食品超市的牛排和星巴克的拿铁）中的塑料含量表示惊讶和质疑，并引用PlasticList网站上的数据。

• **cjflog** 介绍了一个名为Laboratory.love的项目，旨在通过众筹方式让消费者选择具体产品进行塑料检测，以推动供应链透明化。

• **krige** 提到几年前新闻中提到的“能分解塑料的微生物”，质疑其后续发展情况，是否因缺乏资金或其他原因而未取得进展。

• **jjani** 指出PlasticList的报告未明确指出容器类型对微塑料含量的影响，认为容器的材质和使用方式（如温度）可能是微塑料产生的主要原因，而非食品本身。

• **LinguaBrowse** 对PlasticList项目获取1952年朝鲜战争口粮中的奶粉样品的方式表示兴趣，并赞赏其对样本保存和运输条件的详细记录。

• **hobo_in_library** 对塑料检测报告中“水中纸质收据”的检测表示困惑，质疑其检测对象的合理性。

争议焦点：塑料污染的真正来源及其对健康的实际影响。一些讨论者认为工业加工过程是主要来源，而非家用塑料制品；另一些人则对研究方法和塑料含量的健康风险表示怀疑。

data.title: MCP is eating the world
data.author: emschwartz
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MCP（Multi-Agent Communication Protocol）的技术价值、应用场景、安全性及其未来前景

不同观点：
• **对MCP的商业宣传持怀疑态度**：[runlaszlorun]、[pabzu] 等人认为，MCP的宣传有过度炒作之嫌，尤其是当推广MCP的公司本身就从该技术中获利时。他们指出，这种"新技术是救世主"的论调并不新鲜，可能只是商业利益驱动下的营销手段。
  
• **MCP的实际应用价值**：[faxmeyourcode] 强调了MCP在企业内部工具集成的价值，尤其是在自动化复杂任务方面，如通过Jira和Confluence的集成加速任务处理。然而，[0x500x79] 则指出MCP并非适用于所有场景，过度推广可能导致误解其适用范围。

• **MCP的技术成熟度与安全性问题**：[wunderwuzzi23] 和 [neuroelectron] 提到，MCP的生态系统尚不成熟，存在安全漏洞和风险，如通过自然语言处理的漏洞可能导致攻击。此外，[Animats] 认为MCP每次交易都需要经过LLM处理，增加了成本。

• **MCP的应用障碍与改进建议**：[cosbgn] 指出，某些公司期望用户自行托管MCP，增加了使用难度。而[dack] 则提出未来MCP的优化方向，如通过AI自动发现和连接服务，简化用户体验。

• **MCP在消费者技术中的局限性**：[klabb3] 认为，MCP在消费者技术领域的影响有限，因为大型B2C公司如Facebook、Twitter等更关注广告收入，而非开放API，这与他们的商业利益相悖。

• **MCP的技术实现与开发者反馈**：[jlowin] 认为MCP的规范复杂且易被误用，如AI生成的代码可能引发误解。此外，[BLanen] 和 [fennecbutt] 对MCP的技术实现提出质疑，认为其本质上只是对现有API的简单包装，且依赖于LLM的概率输出，缺乏保证。

补充讨论：
• **MCP的用户体验问题**：[remram] 分享了使用MCP运行自定义功能的糟糕体验，指出LLM在处理函数调用时存在不一致性，这增加了调试难度。

争议焦点：
• **MCP是否被过度炒作** 及其 **是否适用于所有场景** 是讨论的核心争议点。一方认为MCP带来了实质性的技术进步，尤其在企业工具集成方面；另一方则认为其应用范围有限，且在消费者技术中难以推广，同时存在技术不成熟和安全性问题。

data.title: Rules Clobber Goals
data.author: kolyder
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了规则相比于目标在行为改变中的重要性。一个单独的行动无法定义你，但持续的选择和行为可以。设定目标容易，实现难，因为动机不稳定。规则帮助排除对动机的依赖，提前做出选择，减少内心争论。将目标转化为具体规则，并与特定时间或事件绑定，能提高坚持的可能性。规则应简单可持续， brutal而短暂的规则不如持久简单的规则有效。规则帮助评估目标的代价，并应认真执行，习惯的累积决定了最终的结果。文章引用詹姆斯·克利尔的《原子习惯》强调了习惯对生活的影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何制定和呈现规则以促进健康生活方式

不同观点：
• Gopalv认为不应滥用规则来强制推行某种纯粹或专制的生活方式。他指出，这种方式可能会让人感到压迫，且难以遵循。
• Gopalv支持CGP Grey的“主题”概念，而不是简单地制定规则。他引用了一个视频链接，其中讨论了用“趋向健康”的主题代替硬性规定（如“吃健康食物”）。这种方法强调逐步改善，而不是严格的规则。

补充讨论：
• Gopalv的观点反映了一种对灵活性和渐进性生活方式改变的偏好，认为这种方式更具可持续性和人性化。
• 引用的CGP Grey视频可能提供了进一步的论据和例子，支持通过设定大方向或主题来引导行为，而不是通过强制性规则来限制行为。
• 争议的焦点可能在于如何平衡规则的必要性与个人自由之间的关系，特别是在促进公共健康和个人选择方面。

44378217.article_content:
Skip to content
Rules Clobber Goals
One workout doesn’t make you an athlete any more than one cigarette makes you a smoker. But you are an accumulation of
your recurring choices and actions
. We set goals to motivate ourselves. But, of course, we’re better at setting goals than reaching them. This is because motivation is fickle.
Rules help remove motivation from the equation. Setting rules can help you make choices in advance. You can’t argue with yourself if a decision was already made.
To transform a goal into a rule, make it highly specific. Tie it to an ultimatum or a cue, like a time of day, place, or preceding event. The fewer decisions involved in following your rule and the more routinized, the more likely it will stick.
Goal
Rule
I want to lose 20 pounds.
No refined carbs in the house.
I want to get fit.
Work out for 30 minutes a day.
Read 20 books this year.
Read 30 minutes a day.
Sleep 8 hours a night.
No screens after 8 p.m.
Don’t abuse rules to force a puritanical or tyrannical lifestyle.
Do what you can sustainably do every day.
A brutal rule you follow for a week is worth less than a simple one you follow for a year.
Living with rules can help you determine the price of a goal and see if you can realistically pay it. Once you commit to a rule, take it deadly seriously. If one of your ethical rules is to never steal or cheat on a partner, why not hold to one of your habitual rules with the same conviction?
“You get what you repeat. Your outcomes are a lagging measure of your habits.”
~James Clear, Atomic Habits (

data.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Based on SQLite
data.author: emzo
data.article_summary: Haiku.rag 是一个基于 SQLite 的 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 库，支持本地运行而无需额外服务器。它具备多种功能，包括支持多种嵌入提供商（如 Ollama、VoyageAI、OpenAI）、混合搜索（结合向量搜索和全文搜索）、文件监控和多种文件格式解析（如 PDF、DOCX、HTML 等）。用户可通过命令行界面（CLI）管理文档、执行搜索，或通过 Python 客户端在自有应用程序中调用 Haiku.rag。该工具还提供 MCP 服务器功能，支持 AI 助手集成。安装时默认使用 Ollama 提供嵌入模型，但可配置其他提供商如 VoyageAI 或 OpenAI。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于结合全文搜索和语义/向量搜索的系统及其应用场景

不同观点：
• [anoojb] 认为可以构建一个结合廉价词法（全文本搜索）和语义/向量搜索的系统，使用SQLite并根据输入选择最佳搜索方法。该观点支持利用SQLite实现多功能搜索，兼顾性能和成本。

• [wredcoll] 对该工具的具体问题解决能力表示困惑，认为尽管看到了流行关键词如"lexical"和"semantic search"，但仍不清楚该工具的实际应用场景和解决的问题。这反映出对工具目的和功能的不明确性。

• [rcarmo] 指出，这类工具（包括SQLite-vec等扩展）能够在有限的计算资源下实现强大的功能。该评论认可了此类工具在资源受限环境下的高效性，并提到了当前流行的相关技术扩展。

• [almosthere] 则关注SQLite是否原生支持嵌入式搜索（embedding search），或者该功能是否由外部工具提供。此评论反映了用户对工具功能来源及其与SQLite原生功能关系的疑问。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于该工具的实际用途和功能实现细节，尤其是[wredcoll]对工具具体解决问题能力的质疑与其他评论者对技术潜力的认可形成了对比。

• [rcarmo] 提到了当前技术趋势，如SQLite-vec扩展，这表明在技术社区中，向量搜索和SQLite结合是一个受到关注的发展方向。

• [almosthere] 提出的关于SQLite是否原生支持某些功能的疑问，揭示了用户在工具依赖性和功能扩展方面的关注点。

Haiku SQLite RAG
A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) library on SQLite.
Features
Local SQLite
: No need to run additional servers
Support for various embedding providers
: You can use Ollama, VoyageAI, OpenAI or add your own
Hybrid Search
: Vector search using
sqlite-vec
combined with full-text search
FTS5
, using Reciprocal Rank Fusion
File monitoring
when run as a server automatically indexing your files
Extended file format Support
: Parse 40+ file formats including PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, audio and more. Or add a url!
MCP server
Exposes functionality as MCP tools.
CLI commands
Access all functionality from your terminal
Python client
Call
haiku.rag
from your own python applications.
Installation
uv pip install haiku.rag
By default Ollama (with the
mxbai-embed-large
model) is used for the embeddings.
For other providers use:
VoyageAI
:
uv pip install haiku.rag --extra voyageai
OpenAI
:
uv pip install haiku.rag --extra openai
Configuration
You can set the directories to monitor using the
MONITOR_DIRECTORIES
environment variable (as comma separated values) :
#
Monitor single directory
export
MONITOR_DIRECTORIES=
"
/path/to/documents,/another_path/to/documents
"
If you want to use an alternative embeddings provider (Ollama being the default) you will need to set the provider details through environment variables:
By default:
EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=
"
ollama
"
EMBEDDINGS_MODEL=
"
mxbai-embed-large
"
#
or any other model
EMBEDDINGS_VECTOR_DIM=1024
For VoyageAI:
EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=
"
voyageai
"
EMBEDDINGS_MODEL=
"
voyage-3.5
"
#
or any other model
EMBEDDINGS_VECTOR_DIM=1024
VOYAGE_API_KEY=
"
your-api-key
"
For OpenAI:
EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=
"
openai
"
EMBEDDINGS_MODEL=
"
text-embedding-3-small
"
#
or text-embedding-3-large
EMBEDDINGS_VECTOR_DIM=1536
OPENAI_API_KEY=
"
your-api-key
"
Command Line Interface
haiku.rag
includes a CLI application for managing documents and performing searches from the command line:
Available Commands
#
List all documents
haiku-rag list
#
Add document from text
haiku-rag add
"
Your document content here
"
#
Add document from file or URL
haiku-rag add-src /path/to/document.pdf
haiku-rag add-src https://example.com/article.html
#
Get and display a specific document
haiku-rag get 1
#
Delete a document by ID
haiku-rag delete 1
#
Search documents
haiku-rag search
"
machine learning
"
#
Search with custom options
haiku-rag search
"
python programming
"
--limit 10 --k 100
#
Start file monitoring & MCP server (default HTTP transport)
haiku-rag serve
#
--stdio for stdio transport or --sse for SSE transport
All commands support the
--db
option to specify a custom database path. Run
haiku-rag
command
-h
to see additional parameters for a command.
File Monitoring & MCP server
You can start the server (using Streamble HTTP, stdio or SSE transports) with:
#
Start with default HTTP transport
haiku-rag serve
#
--stdio for stdio transport or --sse for SSE transport
You need to have set the
MONITOR_DIRECTORIES
environment variable for monitoring to take place.
File monitoring
haiku.rag
can watch directories for changes and automatically update the document store:
Startup
: Scan all monitored directories and add any new files
File Added/Modified
: Automatically parse and add/update the document in the database
File Deleted
: Remove the corresponding document from the database
MCP Server
haiku.rag
includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes RAG functionality as tools for AI assistants like Claude Desktop. The MCP server provides the following tools:
add_document_from_file
- Add documents from local file paths
add_document_from_url
- Add documents from URLs
add_document_from_text
- Add documents from raw text content
search_documents
- Search documents using hybrid search
get_document
- Retrieve specific documents by ID
list_documents
- List all documents with pagination
delete_document
- Delete documents by ID
Using
haiku.rag

Managing documents

Path

rag

client

HaikuRAG
# Use as async context manager (recommended)
async
with
HaikuRAG
(
"path/to/database.db"
)
as
client
:
# Create document from text
doc
=
await
client
.
create_docum

data.title: Maxar launches intelligence service focused on 'persistent monitoring'
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: Maxar Intelligence推出了名为Sentry的新监控产品，旨在提供可操作的地理空间情报，而不仅限于卫星图像。Sentry通过利用公司250多PB的历史高分辨率卫星影像数据和人工智能技术，帮助客户实时监控全球多个地点的动态，识别潜在威胁或异常活动，例如卫星发射前的迹象或自然灾害对能源设施的威胁。该服务可用于能源安全、全球贸易和禁毒等领域，客户可自定义影像采集频率。此外，Maxar正通过与SkyWatch和SkyFi等平台合作，扩大商业伙伴关系，以更广泛地提供卫星数据。同时，Sentry技术已被应用于支持美国情报和国防任务。

44378231.article_content:
High-resolution satellite imagery of an Istanbul, Turkey, airport. Credit: Maxar Intelligence
WASHINGTON — Maxar Intelligence launched a new monitoring product called Sentry, part of a broader effort to move beyond satellite imagery and become a provider of actionable geospatial intelligence.
The company, based in Westminster, Colorado, operates high-resolution imaging satellites. The new monitoring service would provide customers with continuous surveillance capabilities across multiple global locations simultaneously.
“This type of geospatial intelligence would allow a customer to identify an imminent satellite launch before it happens or to estimate potential threats to energy infrastructure following a natural disaster,” said Dan Smoot, CEO of Maxar Intelligence.
With this new service, Maxar is seeking to compete in the higher-value intelligence market as satellite imagery becomes increasingly commoditized.

Sign up
By submitting this form, you agree to the SpaceNews
privacy policy
and
terms and conditions
and to receive email from us and our partners. You can opt-out at any time.
Peter Wilczynski, chief product officer at Maxar Intelligence, said one of the company’s competitive advantages lies in its vast historical archive. Sentry taps into the company’s 250-plus petabyte collection of high-resolution satellite imagery spanning more than two decades, using AI to cross-reference current observations with historical patterns and anomalies.
The software platform aggregates data from Maxar’s own satellites as well as partner constellations, including both electro-optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites.
Sentry’s potential use cases span from energy security to global trade to combating narcotics. Wilczynski cited the example of tracking fentanyl precursors entering the United States. A government agency could direct Maxar to monitor specific ports or airfields in Mexico and the U.S. Once those points of interest are established, satellites are tasked to capture frequent imagery, while the software autonomously flags unusual patterns — such as unexpected cargo volumes or vehicle activity.
The company is offering users the ability to set collection rates — daily, weekly, or monthly — based on the level of insight needed. “So that you can start understanding the movement of material and the patterns of activity over time,” Wilczynski said.
Expanding commercial partnerships
Maxar is also expanding partnerships with Earth intelligence platforms that aggregate imagery from multiple satellite constellations. These partnerships help democratize access to satellite data by reaching customers who might not otherwise have the resources to work directly with satellite operators.
Last year, Maxar signed an agreement with SkyWatch to provide high-resolution imagery through SkyWatch’s platform. This week, the company announced a similar partnership with the Earth intelligence firm SkyFi, giving SkyFi access to Maxar’s high-resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain data and historical archives.
These agreements reflect broader industry trends as satellite imagery becomes more accessible and companies compete on analytical capabilities rather than raw data collection.
Government demand
The technologies underlying Sentry are already being deployed in programs supporting U.S. intelligence and defense missions through the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency’s Luno program, Wilczynski told
SpaceNews
.
Luno, a
nearly $500 million multi-vendor initiativ
e, aims to leverage commercial geospatial technology for government applications.
Maxar recently secured a task order of undisclosed value under the Luno A program for “rapid identification of aircraft, ships, vehicles and railcars, object counts and classification” across multiple locations. The contract focuses on “laying the groundwork for identifying trends and anomalies,” according to the company.
The Luno program marks a change in how intelligence agencies work with the private sector. Rather than simply purchasing imagery, NGA is now asking companies to provide analytical reports about activities in specific locations over set time periods, leaving vendors to determine the best methods for collecting and analyzing the necessary data.
This approach has created new opportunities for companies like Maxar and competitors like BlackSky, which announced a $24 million, four-year Luno A task order on June 24 for global monitoring of military and economic facilities.

data.title: Scientists discover unknown organelle inside our cells
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: 科学家在细胞内发现了一种未知的细胞器，称为“半融合体”（hemifusome）。这一发现由弗吉尼亚大学和美国国立卫生研究院的研究团队通过低温电子断层扫描技术（cryo-ET）实现。半融合体在细胞内负责协助囊泡的形成及细胞内物质的分类、回收和废物处理。该细胞器对理解某些遗传疾病，如Hermansky-Pudlak综合征等，具有重要意义。这些疾病与细胞内物质处理障碍有关。研究人员希望通过进一步研究半融合体，探索其在健康和疾病中的作用，进而开发针对遗传疾病的新疗法。相关研究发表在《Nature Communications》期刊上。

Cryo-electron tomography observation of hemifused vesicles at the leading edge of cultured cells. Credit:
Nature Communications
(2025). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-025-59887-9
The discovery of an unknown organelle inside our cells could open the door to new treatments for devastating inherited diseases.
The
organelle
, a type of specialized structure, has been dubbed a "hemifusome" by its discoverers at the University of Virginia School of Medicine and the National Institutes of Health. This little organelle has a big job helping our cells sort, recycle and discard important cargo within themselves, the scientists say. The new discovery could help scientists better understand what goes wrong in genetic conditions that disrupt these essential housekeeping functions.
"This is like discovering a new recycling center inside the cell," said researcher Seham Ebrahim, Ph.D., of UVA's Department of Molecular Physiology and Biological Physics. "We think the hemifusome helps manage how cells package and process material, and when this goes wrong, it may contribute to diseases that affect many systems in the body."
One such condition is Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome, a
rare genetic disorder
that can cause albinism,
vision problems
, lung disease and issues with blood clotting. Problems with how cells handle cargo are at the root of many such disorders.
"We're just beginning to understand how this new organelle fits into the bigger picture of cell health and disease," Ebrahim said. "It's exciting because finding something truly new inside cells is rare—and it gives us a whole new path to explore."
Tomographic reconstruction of direct hemifusome in a COS-7 cell. Direct hemifusome in a COS-7 cell reveal a dense structure embedded within the hydrophobic interior of the bilayers at the junction of HD and two heterotypic vesicles. Video is displayed at 24 fps. Scale bar: 100 nm. Credit:
Nature Communications
(2025). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-025-59887-9
Hello to the hemifusome
Ebrahim and her team at UVA Health worked with Bechara Kachar, MD, and colleagues Amirrasoul Tavakoli, Ph.D., and Shiqiong Hu, Ph.D., at the National Institutes of Health to identify the organelle, which comes and goes as needed by the cell. They took advantage of UVA's expertise in
cryo-electron tomography
(cryo-ET)—a powerful imaging method that "freezes" cells in time—to create striking images of the organelle.
The scientists believe hemifusomes facilitate the formation of vesicles, tiny blister-like sacs that act as mixing bowls, and of organelles made up of multiple vesicles. This process is critical to cellular sorting, recycling and debris disposal, the researchers report.
"You can think of vesicles like little delivery trucks inside the cell," said Ebrahim, of UVA's Center for Membrane and Cell Physiology. "The hemifusome is like a loading dock where they connect and transfer cargo. It's a step in the process we didn't know existed."
While the hemifusomes have escaped detection until now, the scientists say they are surprisingly common in certain parts of our cells. The researchers are eager to better understand their importance to proper cellular function and learn how problems with them could be contributing to disease. Such insights, they say, could lead to targeted treatments for a range of serious genetic disorders.
"This is just the beginning," Ebrahim said. "Now that we know hemifusomes exist, we can start asking how they behave in healthy cells and what happens when things go wrong. That could lead us to new strategies for treating complex genetic diseases."
The researchers have
published
their findings in the journal
Nature Communications
.

On LinkedIn,

a variant of the
N-Queens
problem. A community version of the game (rather, puzzle) can be found

Recently, we saw it solved using

The Puzzle
You are given a N-colored square-shaped board of size N. You must place N queens on the board such that:
Each row, each column, and each color region has exactly one queen.
No two queens touch each other diagonally.
Note that placing two queens in the same diagonal is acceptable, as long as they are not diagonally adjacent (unlike in Chess).

We will tackle the problem using a backtracking approach. This means, we will place a queen on a plausible cell on the board; check if the current configuration can be extended to a full solution; continue if so, and
backtrack
otherwise, finding a different plausible cell to put the queen on.
To aid our discussion, let us introduce some terminology.
A
partial placement
is a set of positions on the board.
A partial placement is
sound
if it does not violate any of the constraints of the problem, i.e., no two queens are in the same row, column, color region, or are diagonally adjacent. We usually refer to such placements as

.
A partial solution

which can be used to
encode non-deterministic (i.e, branching) computation. Since

is a monad transformer rather than a monad (like the list monad), it can also be composed with other monadic effects. The
LogicT

fair
disjunction, which guarantees that the second computation will make progress even if the first computation is non-terminating. This can also be useful in some cases even if the computations are finite, since an interleaved exploration strategy wouldn’t have to exhaust the first branch before exploring the second one. • [imglorp] 提出分布式操作系统研究是否会在当前基础设施进步的背景下复兴的问题，并特别提到Kubernetes等现代技术可能需要新的想法和灵感。

• [api] 认为过去分布式系统的研究被放弃了很可惜，提到Mosix、OpenMosix、Beowulf等类似项目，并讨论了分布式OS的优缺点。他还提出了无服务器架构可能是一个更好的架构选择，认为这种架构可以消除传统系统的复杂性。

• [killerstorm] 关注Amoeba系统的安全性，特别提到48位数字在暴力破解方面的安全性假设。

• [KingOfCoders] 个人回忆，提到Amoeba项目与自己硕士考试相关，带有怀旧性质。

• [sodimel] 对Guido van Rossum曾参与Amoeba项目表示惊讶，突显出该项目在技术史上的有趣联系。

补充讨论：
• 技术复活的可能性：[haunter] 和 [imglorp] 都提到了Amoeba及其类似项目在现代环境中复活的潜力，特别是在虚拟机和现代基础设施上的可行性。

• 分布式OS的优缺点：[api] 详细讨论了分布式OS的优势（如硬件扩展性）和缺点（如硬件一致性问题、跨地理分布的挑战），并与现代无服务器架构进行了对比。

争议焦点：
• 分布式OS的未来：[imglorp] 和 [api] 对分布式OS在现代计算环境中的适用性和未来发展存在潜在分歧，一个看好其复兴，另一个则指出其固有的复杂性和局限性。

• 安全性的假设：[killerstorm] 对Amoeba系统中48位数字的安全性提出了质疑，这在技术上是一个需要进一步讨论和验证的点。

data.title: Timdle – Place historical events in chronological order
data.author: maskinberg
data.article_summary: TIMDLE是一个在线游戏，玩家可以参与今天的 timeline 玩法。游戏规则和具体玩法可以在"How to Play"中查看，玩家还可以通过"Create Game"创建新游戏。如有疑问或需要联系，可以发送邮件至daily.timdle@gmail.com。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一款名为"TIMDLE"的时间线排序游戏的玩法、用户界面及与其他类似游戏的比较

不同观点：
• NoboruWataya：认为游戏有趣，但质疑事件选择的准确性，特别是涉及到多个时间发生的相同事件（如爱尔兰赢得六国赛），担心可能导致混淆或错误判断。同时调侃了以"-le"命名的游戏泛滥问题。
• zdc1：提到用户界面问题，窗口过小时事件描述被隐藏，导致操作不便，建议可见的滚动条可能更有帮助。
• nonethewiser：提到另一款相似但极为简单的游戏"Timeline"，并给出链接，认为其无入门门槛。
• neuronflux：表示享受游戏，但引述女友对游戏中表情符号反馈不佳，认为不如Wordle宽容。
• mrgoldenbrown：认为该游戏像是电子版的卡牌游戏Chronology，并提到Chronology作为派对游戏的优点，包括易于解释和可合作游戏。
• pmontra：猜测游戏是否受启发于2022年的桌游"Trekking Through History"，并指出游戏域名创建于2024年11月。
• xnx：更喜欢从左到右的时间线设计，相比纽约时报的从下到上设计更为赞赏。
• Artooooour：遇到错误提示，但发现给出的两个事件已经是按时间顺序排列的，带有幽默感。
• stuartjohnson12：初始提示令人困惑，误将魏玛恶性通货膨胀事件排在中国文化大革命之前，导致错误答案，认为可能是自身技能问题。
• maskinberg：分享了自己的游戏成绩和链接。
• fournes3：建议制作对数版本的时间线游戏，并给出相关链接供参考。
• rateofclimb：建议游戏结束后每个事件能链接到维基百科条目，以便玩家了解更多信息。
• wavemode：完成了36/36，但其中两次是幸运猜测，建议可以设计成类似Wordle的多次尝试模式，以最少次数排序正确为优胜。

补充讨论：
- 游戏命名方式的调侃和批评（NoboruWataya）。
- 用户界面的可用性问题（zdc1）。
- 与其他类似游戏（Timeline、Chronology、Trekking Through History）的比较（nonethewiser、mrgoldenbrown、pmontra）。
- 时间线事件准确性和潜在混淆问题（NoboruWataya、stuartjohnson12）。
- 游戏设计改进建议，如对数时间线和更多互动（fournes3、rateofclimb、wavemode）。
